image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a forest floor composed of pine needles, small twigs, and rocks. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow spots and bands. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is broad, and the limbs are short and stout. The tail tapers to a point and extends towards the bottom right.
